    Socle families under algebra equivalence #

    An algebra equivalence transports a complete primitive-projective presentation label by label. This file records that transport before identifying the corresponding embedded socle ideals.

    source
    theorem MagnitudeConjecture.map_moduleSocle_le_of_semilinearEquiv {R : Type u₁} {T : Type u₂} [Ring R] [Ring T] {M : Type v₁} {N : Type v₂} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module T N] (σ : R ≃+* T) [RingHomInvPair σ.toRingHom σ.symm.toRingHom] [RingHomInvPair σ.symm.toRingHom σ.toRingHom] (e : M ≃ₛₗ[σ.toRingHom] N) :
    Submodule.map (↑e) (moduleSocle R M) ≤ moduleSocle T N

    A semilinear equivalence over a ring equivalence carries the source socle into the target socle.

    source
    theorem MagnitudeConjecture.map_moduleSocle_eq_of_semilinearEquiv {R : Type u₁} {T : Type u₂} [Ring R] [Ring T] {M : Type v₁} {N : Type v₂} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module T N] (σ : R ≃+* T) [RingHomInvPair σ.toRingHom σ.symm.toRingHom] [RingHomInvPair σ.symm.toRingHom σ.toRingHom] (e : M ≃ₛₗ[σ.toRingHom] N) :
    Submodule.map (↑e) (moduleSocle R M) = moduleSocle T N

    A semilinear equivalence over a ring equivalence carries the source socle exactly onto the target socle.

    IsUniserialModule R M ↔ IsUniserialModule T N

    Uniseriality is invariant under a semilinear equivalence whose scalar map is a ring equivalence.
